scope: Static disassembly only. CloudCard six-plane tests/compaction have a separate execution oracle. Full external Visibility occlusion classification is not implemented or verified.

cloudCard.cameraFrustumMatrix: +0x1c0..+0x1f0, column-major float32; explicit stored CPU matrix
cloudCard.planeNormalization: lengthSquared = z*z + (x*x + y*y), float32 each operation; divide all four lanes by float32 sqrt only when lengthSquared > 0
cloudCard.sphereDot: float32((x*nx + z*nz) + (y*ny + d)) with float32 products/pairwise sums
cloudCard.reject: -radius > planeDot; tangency and unordered comparisons keep the candidate
cloudCard.candidateStorage: record+0x70 xyzw sphere; initialized status 0xffffffff; sorted record traversal order
cloudCard.compaction: status==0: decrement count, copy last pointer/status/sphere to current slot, recheck same index

externalVisibilityPending.fallback: global 0x10203be90 != 0, camera+0x10 null, or (Visibility+0x218 == 0 and global 0x10203bf08 != 1)
externalVisibilityPending.fallbackWrites: r8b==0: return without changing statuses. r8b!=0: memset(statuses, 0xff, count*4). CloudCard passes 0, retaining initialized 0xffffffff.
externalVisibilityPending.mxcsr: original MXCSR OR 0xe040: FTZ, DAZ, rounding bits 11 = toward zero; restored on return
externalVisibilityPending.workRemaining: Four-sphere SIMD batch, reciprocal approximation/refinement, screen/mip selection, visibility buffer lookup, scalar tail recursion and debug branch; real buffers and complete classification are pending.
